desc: four players at the prologue's end (Rogueport, Goombella only): players 3 and 4 each get a different lent partner (Koops, Flurrie); player 4's L skips Koops (player 3's) for Yoshi. Shots: lent_both ('3P' over Koops, '4P' over Flurrie), p4_next (Yoshi), pause_1..pause_3 (the tabs: Party shows Goombella only)
